fb_text:
Your first hire doesn't know what you know.

Every gate code, every client quirk, every "how we do it here" lives in your head right now. That's fine when it's just you in the truck. The day you hand someone the keys, your phone becomes the help desk.

FieldNotes moves that knowledge out of your head and into the crew's pocket. Your guy texts the bot a question and gets the answer — from your own notes, not from you.

Try the 60-second demo: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
